description: Read-only XRPL current-account-state lookup for one account. `account` must be a valid XRPL classic account address; the result returns the current balance, sequence, owner count, flags, and account settings without submitting or modifying any XRPL transaction, and calls remain subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for current account state only; use n9t2_xrpl_get_transaction or n9t2_xrpl_list_account_transactions for transaction history, and n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data for raw ledger objects.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose current account state should be retrieved.
account.title: Account

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_account_info
